scope: Analytical prospective sensitivity calculation, not model execution, not a new admission protocol. 40 remaining proposals in current roster, zero independently admitted; not a global upper bound on grammar space. H38N8A absolute probe engineering gates distinct from future paired G3-vs-G2 improvement test.

method.test: one-sided exact conditional McNemar, unconditional planning power integrating random discordant count
method.formula: M~Bin(n,q); B|M=m~Bin(m,(q+delta)/(2q)); k(m)=smallest k with P(Bin(m,.5)>=k)<=alpha; power=sum_m P(M=m) P(B>=k(m)|M=m). MDE by bisection delta in [0,q], null if max power<.8. Numerical binomial recurrence and bisection in chat tool, no runner/model fit.
method.limits: Rows within construction families are dependent; iid is a simplifying sensitivity scenario, not validated actual power nor guaranteed upper/lower bound. Need pilot estimates of family-level paired contrasts, discordance, correlation, and cluster-aware power simulation with independent final exam families. Alpha .0125 is hypothetical four-test planning scenario, not modification of existing H38N8A .05/13 bootstrap gates. HOLD uses separate weighted BA ceiling, no subsampling. No empirical q or feasible effect estimate; MDE is not maximum possible gain, and low power is not model FAIL.

decision: Recommend semantic validation of remaining 13 directional and 27 factorial candidates first. A smaller explicitly revised exploratory probe may be useful; no claim of confirmatory 5pp gain and no change of target to MDE merely to get PASS. B expansion modestly improves planning power, not enough for 5pp; C 1:1 improves eval precision at cost of fit data; compare after review with group-aware uncertainty and fixed budget. D polarity removal unsupported by sample size alone. Original H38N8A 90 family design remains HOLD; no silent change, no corpus, G2 unchanged, no model fitting. Future independent gain exam design separate.
